Class DefineBitsJPEG4Tag

com.jpexs.decompiler.flash.tags.DefineBitsJPEG4Tag
All Implemented Interfaces:
AloneTag, BoundedTag, CharacterIdTag, Exportable, HasSeparateAlphaChannel, NeedsCharacters, TreeItem, HasCharacterId, Serializable
public class DefineBitsJPEG4Tag extends ImageTag implements AloneTag, HasSeparateAlphaChannel
DefineBitsJPEG4 tag - Contains a JPEG image with alpha channel and deblocking parameter. (optionally a PNG or GIF without the separate alpha channel)
